test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully and decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

**Statements:**

1. Some kites are birds.

2. All birds are black.

**Conclusions:**

Ⅰ. All black birds are kites.

Ⅱ. Some black things are kites.

options.text: Neither conclusions Ⅰ nor Ⅱ follow.
Both conclusions Ⅰ and Ⅱ follow.

solution:
From the given statements:

1. Some kites are birds.

2. All birds are black.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eddbb5841eb016816cd088d0372f7323a4ec4c88cc5473fca844b6b2f5242a37.png] 

Now we consider the conclusions:

**Ⅰ. All black birds are kites: **From the diagram and the statements given we can clearly say that not all kites are birds and therefore it will be wrong to say that all black birds are kites. Thus the conclusion does not follow.

**Ⅱ. Some black things are kites: **All birds are black and some birds are kites so it can be said that some black birds are kites and which can be rephrased as some black things are kites. So the conclusion follows.

Since **only conclusion Ⅱ follows.**

Hence **the correct answer is option 2).**

179:
